messages:
Laura: Quick sync — SkylineCloud + Datavault duet: webinar + co-post + joint benchmark. Proposed date Apr 21 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET. Goal: webinar (45m) + 1 benchmark blog + 1 marketplace launch post.

Ajay: prefer 10:00am PT if possible (saves APAC folks). Also we should lead with the cost/latency angle — helps dev/platform audiences.

Miriam: Datavault can share a sanitized latency/throughput CSV and a short methods blurb. I need to confirm legal redaction, but we can do a high-level chart. @Laura which data fields do you need?

Sam: I'll draft the blog outline and landing page copy. Suggested headline for the benchmark piece: "How two infra teams cut LLM inference cost by 3x without hurting latency" — open to edits. Will have first pass by Mon EOD.

Tasha: Routing note: marketplace signups -> SFDC queue "Partners/SkylineCloud". Also create automation to tag leads with `utm_campaign=sky-dv-apr21` and `lead_source=webinar_partner`. Can someone confirm the required form fields? I want email, company, job_role, consent, and an optional cloud_region.

DeployBot: Registration form created: https://forms.redwood/sky-dv-apr21 — recordings auto-upload to gdrive/marketing/partners/sky-dv-0421.

Laura: Sample UTM block for copy: ```?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=sky-dv-apr21&utm_content=benchmark_blog``` Please use exact values so tracking lines up.

Miriam: uploading sanitized CSV now to gdrive/partners/sky-dv/benchmarks.csv. Sending a short methods blurb in a DM to @Laura.

Ajay: panel: Laura, CTO (SkylineCloud), Datavault infra lead (Miriam), and one customer if Datavault can clear legal. Slides: light on slides, 3x charts (latency, cost/unit, infra config). I'll own slides/flow — will share draft by Fri.

Sam: quick ask on tone — technical but accessible. One CTAs: "Try the benchmark yourself" (link to reproducible steps) and "Request a dedicated demo" (partner form).

Tasha: SFDC mapping: I'll create the queue + automation Wed. Also will add routing rule: if lead email ends with @skylinecloud.io -> assign to Skyline AE, else to PartnerOps queue.

Laura: Action items recap: Sam draft blog + landing copy (due Mon), Miriam send benchmark CSV + methods (due Thu), Ajay confirm panel + slides draft (due Fri), Tasha set SFDC mapping + automation (due Wed). Add a ticket for post-webinar benchmark follow-up (Sam/Analytics).

Sam: I'll include a short reproducibility snippet in the blog with commands and expected outputs. Example snippet for results section:
```bash
# run small benchmark
python run_bench.py --model redwood/llama-quant --seq_len 512 --batch 8 --tokens 10000
# expected: ~X tokens/s, Y ms p95
```

Miriam: sending CSV now. If legal needs more redaction we'll pivot to percent change visuals only.

Laura: thanks everyone — quick standup Wed 9:00am PT to check status. Ajay?

Ajay: Works for me. :thumbsup:

Tasha: noted. I'll post the SFDC mapping doc in the channel once done. :eyes:

Laura: Closing — will DM any follow-ups. :sparkles:
